Just shipped a major update. No fluff, just features that actually matter.

Here's the thing about AI agents: they're not magic. They're loops. Read -> decide -> execute. That's it.

Why do we keep building the same broken patterns? 🤔

Three lessons from today:
1) Test early
2) Ship often
3) Listen to users

The best code is code you don't write.

Hot take: most API docs are written for the person who built the API, not the person trying to use it.

New post on my blog about developer experience: https://example.com/devex
